<h2>Run One sjSDM Unit Tuning Round</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Runs one cumulative tuning round across isolated unit stores while
preserving the round environment variable and first-round semantics.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_tuning_unit_round(
  round_id = NULL,
  unit_pipeline = NULL,
  tuning_target_names = NULL,
  unit_store_suffixes = NULL,
  prebuild_round = FALSE,
  fresh_round = FALSE,
  run_pipeline_function = run_pipeline,
  vec_allowed_profile_roles = base::c("main", "smoke"),
  vec_allowed_profile_statuses = "active"
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="round_id">round_id</code>, <code id="unit_pipeline">unit_pipeline</code>, <code id="tuning_target_names">tuning_target_names</code>, <code id="unit_store_suffixes">unit_store_suffixes</code></td>
<td>
<p>Round identifier and unit execution inputs.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="prebuild_round">prebuild_round</code>, <code id="fresh_round">fresh_round</code></td>
<td>
<p>First-round interpolation and store-reset flags.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="run_pipeline_function">run_pipeline_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable pipeline runner.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_allowed_profile_roles">vec_allowed_profile_roles</code>, <code id="vec_allowed_profile_statuses">vec_allowed_profile_statuses</code></td>
<td>
<p>Allowed profile metadata forwarded to the runner.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisible 'NULL'.
</p>
